messages:
Rae (Platform): quick Q  we had an overnight on-call rotation, team ordered a shared Uber Eats to the on-call room and i paid with my personal card. company expects meals for night shifts, but how do we split the receipt for individual claims?
Dan (Oncall): same situation last month. the vendor sent one receipt for the group order listing items but charged as one txn. i just attached the receipt and listed my items in the form.
Priya (Finance): policy: group meals for business (on-call, recruitment, customer dinners) are reimbursable but we need to attribute items per person when possible. preferred: itemized receipt showing items per person. if itemization exists, upload it.
Rae (Platform): the receipt shows item names but not which person had what. we kept a short list in the channel after the order. will that work?
Priya (Finance): yes. attach the original Uber Eats receipt + a short allocation note (who ate which items) and a screenshot of the Slack msg or the shared list. Example note: "Rae: Caesar salad $12; Dan: Margherita $10; Sam: fries $5". That is sufficient for small group orders.
Dan (Oncall): what about tips and delivery fees? split proportionally?
Priya (Finance): tip/delivery can be allocated proportionally across participants or assigned to the person who paid. show how you split it in the allocation note. if one person paid full tip and others didn't ask for reimbursement for that portion, mark it as personal.
Avery (People Ops): are alcohol items allowed on on-call meal claims? we had one bottle of beer in the order.
Priya (Finance): alcohol is allowed only when vendor-hosted or approved by manager for a specific business event. personal alcohol on a routine on-call order is non-reimbursable. mark alcohol lines as personal in your allocation.
Rae (Platform): currency: vendor billed in local GBP; our expense system uses USD. any docs needed?
Priya (Finance): attach the card statement showing the charge and the Uber Eats receipt. finance converts using transaction date FX. no extra conversion doc needed.
Dan (Oncall): file naming preferences? Makes approvals faster.
Priya (Finance): name receipts like `lastname_1767009876_ubereats_receipt.jpg` and the allocation note as `lastname_1767009876_allocation.txt` and include the Slack screenshot `channel_1767009876_split.png`.
Rae (Platform): thanks, i'll collect the channel list and submit my line item now. :thumbsup:
ExpenseBot: REMINDER  upload original merchant receipt + allocation note for shared food orders. Alcohol items must be marked personal unless preapproved.
